7. A Chinook salmon can jump out of water with a speed v0 and an angle 𝜃 above the horizontal. What is the speed of the fish when it is at the maximum height?
A. 𝑣0.
B. 𝑣0 cos 𝜃.
C. 𝑣0 sin 𝜃.
D. 0.
datasource_item.generated_question_text:
Q7. A tennis ball is launched with speed u0 at an angle ϕ above the horizontal.
What is the speed of the ball when it is at its maximum height (neglect air
resistance)?
A. u0.
This is incorrect because the vertical component decreases to zero at the top, reducing the speed
from its initial value.
B. u0 cos ϕ.
This is correct because at maximum height the vertical velocity is zero while the horizontal
component remains u0 cos ϕ.
C. u0 sin ϕ.
This is incorrect because u0 sin ϕ is the initial vertical component, which is not the speed at the
top.
D. 0.
This is incorrect because the horizontal component is generally nonzero at the top, so the speed
is not zero.

the ball) or rounding the speed conversion incorrectly.

This is incorrect because it misplaces decimals, effectively treating grams as kilograms or failing
to convert km/hr to m/s.
D. 0.36 m/s.
This is incorrect because it overestimates the result by not using the large combined mass in
the denominator.
